description:
Why can domain experts make AI Agents do more? Drawing on Anthropic’s analysis of roughly 400,000 interactive Claude Code sessions, this episode explains the observed planning-execution split, the persistent returns to task expertise, and a four-field responsibility card for safe delegation.

You’ll learn:
- Which decisions belong to people and agents
- Why precise constraints expand useful action chains
- How to define verification evidence and failure takeover

Follow Tiny Agent. Tiny Agent helps you get better at using AI.
